title: RELEASE OF COMMEMORATIVE POSTAGE STAMP ON DIAMOND JUBILEE OF THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT BY HONOURABLE SHRI NARENDRA MODI, PRIME MINISTER OF INDIA
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 04-02-2021 REGISTRAR GENERAL

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
PRESS RELEASE
RELEASE OF COMMEMORATIVE POSTAGE STAMP
ON DIAMOND JUBILEE OF THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
BY HONOURABLE SHRI NARENDRA MODI, PRIME MINISTER OF INDIA
Honourable High Court of Gujarat completed sixty years of its establishment
on 1st May, 2020. A series of functions were planned to be held as part of grand
celebration of the diamond jubilee of the institution of the High Court of Gujarat, on
1st, 2nd and 3rd May, 2020; with gracious participation by Honourable the Prime
Minister of India in one of the events planned. A postage stamp on the occasion
was also planned to be released to commemorate the completion of sixty years of
existence of this grand institution.
Due to Covid-19 pandemic and resultant lockdown situation, all the
celebrations were stalled and the establishment day of the High Court of Gujarat
was celebrated only by way of an online Full Court Reference held on 1st May,
2020. With the joint efforts of the High Court of Gujarat and Department of Posts,
Government of India, Commemorative Postage Stamp has been finalised and
approved by Honourable the Minister for Communications, Electronics &
Information Technology and Law & Justice, Shri Ravi Shankar Prasad.
The Honourable Prime Minister of India has kindly consented to grace the
function and to do the honours of releasing the Commemorative Postage Stamp of
Diamond Jubilee of the High Court of Gujarat at 10.30 am on 6th February, 2021.
The function is being held in virtual mode, wherein Honourable the Prime Minister
of India Shri Narendra Modi will release the Commemorative Postage Stamp and
address the gathering. Honourable Shri Ravi Shankar Prasad, Minister for
Communications, Electronics & Information Technology and Law & Justice;
Honourable Shri Justice M. R. Shah, Judge Supreme Court of India, Honourable
Shri Vijay Rupani, Chief Minister of State of Gujarat; Honourable Mr. Justice Vikram
Nath, Chief Justice, High Court of Gujarat, Shri Tushar Mehta, learned Solicitor
General of India; Shri Kamal Trivedi, learned Advocate General of State of Gujarat
will also address the gathering.
Press Release - Release of Commemorative Postage Stamp of High Court of Gujarat by Honourable Prime Minister 1/2
Honourable Cabinet and State Minister for Law of State of Gujarat,
Honourable sitting and retired Judges of the High Court of Gujarat, learned
Government Pleader and Public Prosecutor of Gujarat High Court, learned
Additional Solicitor General, learned Senior Advocates of High Court of Gujarat,
Chairman and Vice Chairman of Bar Council of Gujarat, President and Office
Bearers of Gujarat High Court Advocates’ Association and Senior Officers of High
Court Registry are also being invited to the function. Law Colleges of Gujarat State
are also being requested to facilitate viewing of this online function by their law
students and faculties live on https://pmindiawebcast.nic.in/.
The function will start at 10.30 am on 6th February, 2021.
Sd/-
Date: 04-02-2021 REGISTRAR GENERAL
Press Release - Release of Commemorative Postage Stamp of High Court of Gujarat by Honourable Prime Minister 2/2
